title: Inspect returned values and visible state changes
description: You compare the supplied calls through their printed values and argument state.

steps.description: You define one helper using sorted and another using the list's sort method. The later reports print data after each call so you can inspect the difference.
You read helpers that update total, read LOG_LINES, multiply by a parameter, or draw a random value. Their bodies show which values each call observes.

steps.question: Which operation does the second report execute before it displays data after?
steps.answer: It calls f2(data), whose body invokes xs.sort(). The report then reads data in its resulting order.

steps.description: You see the first sort report preserve data and the second show sorted data. The remaining recorded calls print totals 10 and 20, a log-length result 2, a product 14, and two random values.
